reviews.title: Asus for the win
reviews.comment: Works good for anything 14600k and under with good airflow on the vrms. I added a fan and some extra heatsinks to the top mosfets and chokes. Probably wouldn't push it much further than a 14700f. Ram overclocked to 4000mt. No issues.
reviews.author: Brandon Brogren
